reasoning: A plain left-pointing arrow is standard UI navigation chrome ('back' or 'previous') with no concrete object or domain of its own. For real tasks like returning purchases, reverting code, or replying, dedicated icons (package return, curved undo arrow, reply arrow) are much clearer and less ambiguous.
